neural_architecture.intercepts: Two learned constant-token embeddings of width two; do not substitute feature identity embeddings.
neural_architecture.pooling: Concatenate categorical, both continuous and weight-intercept embeddings; batch normalization, linear to five, ReLU, linear to scalar, softmax across feature groups. Same weights pool all three branches.
neural_architecture.head: Pooled branches concatenate; batch normalization and dense hidden width 32; binary logits.
neural_architecture.normalization: Feature-axis normalization for group tensors plus channel normalization in weight and output paths; preserve axes during port.

augmentation: Within each target class, independently permute each feature group while preserving its categorical/raw/substituted triplet. Concatenate positive and negative batches with corresponding labels. Validation unchanged.
